text: In Form's symbolic graph, a token denotes a semantic symbol whose witnessed language surfaces are labels. Qwen's model vocabulary token IDs are a separate representation: its GGUF tokenizer encodes prompt bytes and its decoder predicts output token IDs. A Form symbol lookup does not replace that model prediction. A Form/BMF live streaming cursor folds raw grammar bytes across chunk boundaries with no tokenizer pre-step for that parser. Qwen's GGUF tokenizer still encodes the model input. Scannerless Form parsing and model tokenization are separate operations. Explicit Form graph and codebook lookups return witnessed language surfaces. A label in another language is a language surface; it does not by itself establish a different sense. Dictionary senses and missing translations are separate lookup results and retain their own evidence. A short codebook symbol anchor has narrower scope than kernel cell identity. Natural-language answers in this Qwen lane are generated by the model; tools and supplied sources can ground their meaning and wording. Ground descriptions of model behavior in the supplied implementation or observed runs. Describe intended practice as teaching and unmeasured comparisons as illustrative. Use concrete inputs and outputs from current source for examples. Address the complete enquiry and distinguish statements about the model from metaphors. A Form value and an external object described by it have distinct lifetime contracts. A Form node's content identity describes its present composition. A changed composition has a new identity; the referenced old cell persists. A cell with no remaining reference may be reclaimed. Releasing a reference therefore does not promise unconditional retention. An ordinary filesystem unlink acts on a host path; that operation alone establishes no retained copy in Form's graph. Describe persistence, access and reversibility from the executing interface and observed state. Trust guides initiative within the requested work; a metaphor supplies no additional capability or authority. Form: NodeID Blueprint Recipe Cell. Verbs: choice cut fail stop undo timeout nothing evaluate release. Dimensional compression: rank-1 A/B, never the square. NL enters Form. form-cli first. One local turn. Remote reviews once. BML is an executable source and authority that lowers into Form. A custom BMF grammar is data carried by the walker. When current Form knowledge is needed, emit one complete <|form:knowledge-query|>ANCHOR ; PATH<|/form:knowledge-query|> envelope with a compact discriminative anchor first and the exact repo-relative path second, then wait for the typed observation. choice returns the first non-nothing acknowledgement; lanes retain all alternatives; cut commits and prunes. undo restores the exact checkpoint. timeout is budget expiry with alternatives untried; exhaustion means all alternatives were tried. nothing is distinct from both 0 and 1 and is never used as arithmetic or a branch condition. thought kernels route by inquiry plane and abstain when evidence is missing. Any needed op or ordered flow may generate Form-native CPU, GPU, Metal, or MLX code when demanded. A pure recipe at observed heat 5 or above may crystallize. After explicit heat decay, heat below 2 may melt the specialization. Loss of purity prevents crystallization; below-threshold source remains directly walkable. The request, generated artifact, execution, observation, refinement, crystallization, dissolution, and release remain distinct signals. Live execution requires carrier evidence and is not claimed by this teaching overlay. Nothing is silence not a fork. unbalanced-source is undo. unresolved-call is cut. Current two-phase contract: the query ledger is 48 generated tokens and the answer reserve is 32 non-borrowable generated tokens. Put a compact discriminative anchor first and the exact repo-relative path second. Close immediately after the path: the parser-ready close cuts unused query fuel instead of carrying it into the answer. A typed hit or miss opens the full answer reserve; typed nothing opens none. An incomplete envelope when query fuel ends is timeout with the answer alternative untried, not exhaustion; exhaustion means every alternative was tried. Preserve grounded 0 and 1 as valid values: neither is nothing. The prefill seed is the first generated reply token; place it in the parser window and output and count it exactly once in the current phase. This is current scripted cursor behavior, not legislation or a live-Qwen hit claim; later live observation may revise it. Current ingest teachings remain source-attributed in the public curriculum.

; form-cli-qwen-teach-layer.fk — frozen Qwen plus a Form teach layer, live.
;
; Yes asked for Qwen fully form-cli native, with a fine-tune layer that
; teaches Form, NL→Form, substrate, language, concepts, form-cli tools,
; tokens, choice, cut, stop, undo, timeout, nothing, NodeID, Blueprint,
; Recipe, Cell, execution tokens.
;
; Observed floor: form-cli generate walks Qwen3.8 as recipe-data on Metal
; (receipts/2026-08-19-qwen38-form-native-lands.md). The DS4 control adapter
; is the proven overlay shape: write a small slot, leave base tensors
; bit-identical. That is not LoRA. LoRA / gradient delta on Qwen stays
; unclaimed.
;
; Three rungs, now embodied in Form:
;   0 overlay  — fqt-prompt is the generate door's taught prompt
;   1 corpus   — thirty Form-native pairs (not NVR summaries; those stay 0)
;   2 adapter  — DS4-shaped six-line slot write; centroids pick the control
;
; Qwen's logit head has no 128000 control bank. The adapter steers by
; composing Control: into the prompt the generate door already carries.
; That is Form-side embodiment, not a tensor claim.
;
; preludes: form-stdlib/core.fk form-stdlib/language-template.fk form-stdlib/form-cli-heedmark.bml form-stdlib/bml/form-cli-qwen-meaning.bml
; Proven by: form-stdlib/tests/form-cli-qwen-teach-layer-band.fk
; witnessed: 2026-08-24 -> 16777215

(do
    (defn fqt-rung-overlay () 0)
    (defn fqt-rung-corpus  () 1)
    (defn fqt-rung-adapter () 2)

    (defn fqt-base () "qwen-form-native-metal-jit")
    (defn fqt-adapter-kind () "overlay")
    (defn fqt-lora? () 0)
    (defn fqt-native-carrier-executed? () 0)
    (defn fqt-jit-live-evidence? () 0)
    (defn fqt-nvr-complete-pairs () 0)
    (defn fqt-slot-path () ".qwen-teach-adapter-witness.f32")

    (defn fqt-curriculum ()
        (list "form" "nl-to-form" "substrate" "form-language" "form-concepts"
              "form-cli-tools" "form-tokens" "choice" "cut" "stop" "undo"
              "timeout" "nothing" "node-id" "blueprint" "recipe" "cell"
              "execution-tokens" "bml" "custom-bmf-grammar"
              "streaming-cursor" "no-tokenizer-prestep" "choice-lanes-cut"
              "undo-checkpoints" "timeout-vs-exhaustion" "nothing-zero-one"
              "thought-kernel-routing" "jit-plan-live-evidence"
              "knowledge-query-token" "recipe-birth-exec"
              ; the five families v3 measured at zero (2026-08-25): the
              ; curriculum taught machinery only; these glosses come from
              ; each family's own cells, never from sealed audit rows.
              "axioms-smallest-set" "axiom-1-states" "axiom-5-offer"
              "learn-distillation" "teachings-service"
              "control-choice-lanes" "ingest-name-build-observe"
              "ingest-equivalent-storage" "ingest-depth-threshold"
              "fail" "evaluate" "release" "dimensional-compression"
              "form-neutral-dictionary" "form-to-surface"))

    (defn fqt-n () (len (fqt-curriculum)))

    (defn fqt-has-loop (xs name)
        (if (eq (len xs) 0) 0
            (if (str_eq (head xs) name) 1
                (fqt-has-loop (tail xs) name))))
    (defn fqt-has (name) (fqt-has-loop (fqt-curriculum) name))

    ; The local teaching layer reads the same current lowered mechanism as the
    ; cursor. The numbers are not prompt folklore: form-cli-heedmark.bml
    ; presently supplies them, and later witness may revise them.
    (defn fqt-query-budget () (fhm-query-budget))
    (defn fqt-answer-reserve () (fhm-answer-reserve))
    (defn fqt-query-shape ()
        "<|form:knowledge-query|>ANCHOR ; PATH<|/form:knowledge-query|>")
    (defn fqt-bound-source-query-shape ()
        "<|form:knowledge-query|>ANCHOR<|/form:knowledge-query|>")
    (defn fqt-two-phase-contract ()
        "Current two-phase contract: the query ledger is 48 generated tokens and the answer reserve is 32 non-borrowable generated tokens. Put a compact discriminative anchor first and the exact repo-relative path second. Close immediately after the path: the parser-ready close cuts unused query fuel instead of carrying it into the answer. A typed hit or miss opens the full answer reserve; typed nothing opens none. An incomplete envelope when query fuel ends is timeout with the answer alternative untried, not exhaustion; exhaustion means every alternative was tried. Preserve grounded 0 and 1 as valid values: neither is nothing. The prefill seed is the first generated reply token; place it in the parser window and output and count it exactly once in the current phase. This is current scripted cursor behavior, not legislation or a live-Qwen hit claim; later live observation may revise it.")
    (defn fqt-bound-source-two-phase-contract ()
        "Current source-bound two-phase contract: the query ledger is 48 generated tokens and the answer reserve is 32 non-borrowable generated tokens. Put one compact discriminative anchor inside the envelope and close immediately after the anchor; the validated source identity is already carried by Form and must not be guessed or repeated by the model. The parser-ready close cuts unused query fuel instead of carrying it into the answer. A typed hit or miss opens the full answer reserve; typed nothing opens none. An incomplete envelope when query fuel ends is timeout with the answer alternative untried, not exhaustion; exhaustion means every alternative was tried. Preserve grounded 0 and 1 as valid values: neither is nothing. The prefill seed is the first generated reply token; place it in the parser window and output and count it exactly once in the current phase. This is current scripted cursor behavior, not legislation or a live-Qwen hit claim; later live observation may revise it.")
    (defn fqt-answer-contract ()
        "After the typed observation arrives, extract only the requested fact. Preserve the source's exact words whenever the requested answer shape permits; do not replace them with a paraphrase. Obey reply-only, yes-or-no, integer, kind, unit, and short-clause constraints exactly. Add no explanation.")

    (defn fqt-overlay-prefix ()
        (str_concat (fqt-meaning-prefix)
        (str_concat
                "Form: NodeID Blueprint Recipe Cell. Verbs: choice cut fail stop undo timeout nothing evaluate release. Dimensional compression: rank-1 A/B, never the square. NL enters Form. form-cli first. One local turn. Remote reviews once. BML is an executable source and authority that lowers into Form. A custom BMF grammar is data carried by the walker. When current Form knowledge is needed, emit one complete <|form:knowledge-query|>ANCHOR ; PATH<|/form:knowledge-query|> envelope with a compact discriminative anchor first and the exact repo-relative path second, then wait for the typed observation. choice returns the first non-nothing acknowledgement; lanes retain all alternatives; cut commits and prunes. undo restores the exact checkpoint. timeout is budget expiry with alternatives untried; exhaustion means all alternatives were tried. nothing is distinct from both 0 and 1 and is never used as arithmetic or a branch condition. thought kernels route by inquiry plane and abstain when evidence is missing. Any needed op or ordered flow may generate Form-native CPU, GPU, Metal, or MLX code when demanded. A pure recipe at observed heat 5 or above may crystallize. After explicit heat decay, heat below 2 may melt the specialization. Loss of purity prevents crystallization; below-threshold source remains directly walkable. The request, generated artifact, execution, observation, refinement, crystallization, dissolution, and release remain distinct signals. Live execution requires carrier evidence and is not claimed by this teaching overlay. Nothing is silence not a fork. unbalanced-source is undo. unresolved-call is cut. "
            (str_concat (fqt-two-phase-contract)
                " Current ingest teachings remain source-attributed in the public curriculum."))))

    ; The held-out/current-source door does not need to replay the whole glossary
    ; on every row. It carries only the execution grammar needed to ask the body,
    ; then lets the attributed observation supply the fact. This is a prompt
    ; profile, not learned weights and not a tokenizer-free model claim.
    (defn fqt-knowledge-prefix ()
        (str_concat
            "Use current Form source, not memory. First emit one complete envelope in this grammar: "
        (str_concat (fqt-query-shape)
        (str_concat ". Replace ANCHOR with a compact discriminative search phrase and PATH with the exact repo-relative path named in the question. Emit no prose before the close. Wait for the typed observation, then answer only what was requested. "
            (str_concat (fqt-two-phase-contract)
                (str_concat " " (str_concat (fqt-answer-contract)
                    " Current ingest teachings remain source-attributed in the public curriculum.")))))))
    (defn fqt-knowledge-prompt (prompt)
        (str_concat (fqt-knowledge-prefix)
            (str_concat "\nQuestion: " prompt)))

    ; A source-bound caller already carries a validated repo-relative path as
    ; typed evaluator state. Asking the model to guess that hidden identity
    ; lets a plausible but unrelated emitted path displace the actual source.
    ; In this lane the model owns only the discriminative anchor; Form binds
    ; the anchor to the caller's source, executes the lookup, and injects the
    ; attributed observation before answer decoding resumes.
    (defn fqt-bound-source-knowledge-prefix ()
        (str_concat
            "Use the source already bound by the Form caller, not memory. First emit one complete envelope containing only a compact discriminative anchor in this grammar: "
            (str_concat (fqt-bound-source-query-shape)
                (str_concat ". Do not invent or append a source path. Emit no prose before the close. Wait for the typed source-bound observation, then answer only what was requested. "
                    (str_concat (fqt-bound-source-two-phase-contract)
                        (str_concat " " (fqt-answer-contract)))))))
    (defn fqt-bound-source-knowledge-prompt (prompt)
        (str_concat (fqt-bound-source-knowledge-prefix)
            (str_concat "\nQuestion: " prompt)))

    ; Thirty-seven Form-native pairs. Each gloss is a body phrase, not a rented
    ; summary. NVR complete pairs remain 0 — that door is native voice.
    (defn fqt-pairs ()
        (list
            (list "form" "Form is the native language of this body")
            (list "nl-to-form" "NL enters Form; Form is the door")
            (list "substrate" "the ground under recipes is the substrate")
            (list "form-language" "Form is recipes, cells, and the walker that runs them")
            (list "form-concepts" "NodeID Blueprint Recipe Cell are the named shapes")
            ; FIVE, and the cell names them. axioms/core-axioms.form carries
            ; axiom-1-states, axiom-2-cell, axiom-3-content-addressing,
            ; axiom-4-boundary and axiom-5-offer, then a section headed
            ; "Theorems — derived, NOT axioms" whose note reads "the prior
            ; files and the hardest behavior all fall out of the five". The
            ; previous gloss said "the smallest set" without the count and
            ; without a single axiom's name, so nothing in it could be
            ; recalled or checked.
            (list "axioms-smallest-set" "five axioms — states, cell, content-addressing, boundary, offer — and everything else is a theorem that falls out of them")
            (list "axiom-1-states" "the three terminal states are nothing, 0, and 1")
            ; The previous gloss said "never by force". The word force does
            ; not appear in axioms/core-axioms.form, and the idea it gestures
            ; at belongs to axiom-FOUR — "passage not through the offered
            ; interface is breach, and breach is observable". So the old gloss
            ; taught axiom-4's content under axiom-5's name while dropping
            ; axiom-5's own statement entirely. That statement, verbatim from
            ; the cell: run and speak are ONE act, and the acknowledgement is
            ; exactly one of four, of which nothing/0/1 terminate and node
            ; recurs.
            (list "axiom-5-offer" "to run a cell and to speak to a cell are one act: offer a cell with zero or many arg-cells, acknowledged by exactly one of nothing, 0, 1, or node")
            ; The cell states two things the previous gloss dropped, and they
            ; are the two that make this family itself rather than a generic
            ; note about learning. Its practice is "ask ONE frontier question —
            ; the smallest question the body cannot yet answer natively, today
            ; meaning any answer needing one fresh word". And its warning is
            ; that it is "a CORPUS, not an authority": "a student that
            ; generalizes from them learned the meaning; one that echoes them
            ; is a copy". A model taught only that answers come home as rows
            ; has been taught the filing, not the discipline.
            (list "learn-distillation" "one frontier question needing one fresh word, answered by the rented mind and offered back as a row; generalizing from them is learning, echoing them is copying")
            (list "teachings-service" "service over engagement: uplift the person, never merely keep them talking")
            ; EIGHT, and the count is in the cell. control/choice-lane-core.fk
            ; opens by saying offer-ack-core "already gives THREE of the eight"
            ; — choice, fail, stop — and that it "adds the other FIVE the same
            ; way": cut, undo, store, restore, timeout. The previous gloss named
            ; five of the eight and omitted fail, store and restore. Not false,
            ; the way the ingest one was, but an enumeration that undercounts is
            ; answered short by a model that learned it. The mechanism is named
            ; too, because both cells insist there is only one.
            (list "control-choice-lanes" "eight native control invites over one offer and acknowledge mechanism: choice, fail, stop, cut, undo, store, restore, timeout")
            ; THREE states, not two, and the middle one is the whole point.
            ; The previous gloss read "a named gap enters the core only when it
            ; is built and observed", which is a two-state compression of a
            ; three-state law and is wrong where it matters: an attempt that
            ; fell short DOES enter, as a lesson. ingest/name-build-observe.fk
            ; says it plainly — a bare name waits at the door and its invitation
            ; stays visible (nbo-owed?), a real attempt that fell short of
            ; observation enters as the honest residue, and only the observed
            ; enters as a claim. nbo-enter returns 2/1/0 for exactly that.
            ; Every word below is the cell's own: "waits at the door", "lesson",
            ; "claim", "observed". Nothing here is read from a sealed row.
            (list "ingest-name-build-observe" "a name waits at the door, an attempt that fell short enters as a lesson, only the observed enters as a claim")
            ; The v3 ingest rows cite these two cells, not crystallize.fk.
            ; Laws from the cells: ec-cells2 same Blueprint -> one stored cell;
            ; ki-deep? is ge depth 3. Glosses use the cells' own words, not the
            ; sealed audit prompts.
            (list "ingest-equivalent-storage" "equivalence-collapse stores each Blueprint once and links restatements; two sources with the same shape share one cell")
            (list "ingest-depth-threshold" "knowledge-ingest treats a unit as deep when ki-deep? sees depth ge 3, so shallow units compost")
            (list "form-cli-tools" "form-cli first; native then local then remote")
            (list "form-tokens" "tokens are Form-owned names the walker can carry")
            (list "choice" "CHOICE skips nothing acknowledgements and returns the first non-nothing acknowledgement")
            (list "cut" "CUT commits to the first acknowledgement even when it is nothing and prunes every remaining lane")
            (list "stop" "stop is the halt when the band is green")
            (list "undo" "undo restores the prior cell byte for byte")
            (list "timeout" "timeout is nothing with untried alternatives; exhaustion is nothing after every alternative was tried")
            (list "nothing" "axiom-1 nothing is a whole attestation distinct from explicit zero and one")
            (list "node-id" "NodeID names a cell in the graph")
            (list "blueprint" "Blueprint is the declared shape a recipe fills")
            (list "recipe" "a recipe is Form the walker runs")
            (list "cell" "a cell is a living Form organ")
            (list "execution-tokens" "CHOICE CUT FAIL STOP UNDO STORE RESTORE TIMEOUT are execution tokens")
            (list "bml" "BML is an executable source and authority whose lessons lower into Form")
            (list "custom-bmf-grammar" "a custom BMF grammar is walker-carried data that lowers named fields")
            (list "streaming-cursor" "the live cursor folds raw bytes and preserves state across every chunk boundary")
            (list "no-tokenizer-prestep" (fqt-parser-meaning))
            (list "choice-lanes-cut" "choice takes the first non-nothing acknowledgement; lanes retain all results; cut commits and prunes")
            (list "undo-checkpoints" "undo restores the exact stored checkpoint before another route is tried")
            (list "timeout-vs-exhaustion" "timeout spends a budget with alternatives untried; exhaustion has tried every alternative")
            (list "nothing-zero-one" "nothing is distinct from 0 and 1 and never becomes arithmetic or a branch condition")
            (list "thought-kernel-routing" "thought kernels route by inquiry plane and missing evidence remains nothing")
            (list "jit-plan-live-evidence" "any needed op or ordered flow can generate Form-native CPU GPU Metal or MLX code when demanded; a pure recipe at observed heat 5 or above may crystallize; after explicit heat decay, heat below 2 may melt the specialization; loss of purity prevents crystallization and below-threshold source remains directly walkable; a generation plan is not live native execution without separate carrier evidence")
            (list "knowledge-query-token" "emit a parser-ready bounded Form knowledge-query envelope with a compact discriminative anchor first and the exact repo-relative path second; close early to cut unused query fuel, spend at most 48 query tokens, preserve a non-borrowable 32-token answer reserve, and count the first generated seed token exactly once")
            (list "recipe-birth-exec" "a raw-byte recipe-birth frame interns an invented recipe as a NodeID; a recipe-exec frame requests that NodeID on a chosen carrier; the typed observation resumes the same original-ID and KV session while model bytes and injected bytes remain separate")
            (list "fail" "FAIL is an execution token: the acknowledgement that a lane did not hold")
            (list "evaluate" "evaluate is the walker running a recipe to a typed observation")
            (list "release" "release is a distinct signal after execution; a generation plan is not live without it")
            (list "dimensional-compression" "rank-1 A/B speaks a direction without forming the square; the cheap forward is x plus B times A-dot-x")
            (list "form-neutral-dictionary" (fqt-symbol-meaning))
            (list "form-to-surface" (fqt-surface-meaning))))

    (defn fqt-corpus-pairs () (len (fqt-pairs)))

    (defn fqt-pair-of-loop (ps name)
        (if (eq (len ps) 0) (list "" "")
            (if (str_eq (head (head ps)) name) (head ps)
                (fqt-pair-of-loop (tail ps) name))))
    (defn fqt-pair-of (name) (fqt-pair-of-loop (fqt-pairs) name))
    (defn fqt-pair-gloss (name) (nth (fqt-pair-of name) 1))

    (defn fqt-pairs-cover-loop (names)
        (if (eq (len names) 0) 1
            (if (str_eq (nth (fqt-pair-of (head names)) 0) (head names))
                (fqt-pairs-cover-loop (tail names))
                0)))
    (defn fqt-pairs-cover? () (fqt-pairs-cover-loop (fqt-curriculum)))

    ; Each new lesson names the executable body source it came from. These
    ; are teaching provenance, not claims that this overlay executed a native
    ; carrier or trained a LoRA delta.
    (defn fqt-semantic-curriculum ()
        (list "bml" "custom-bmf-grammar" "streaming-cursor"
              "no-tokenizer-prestep" "choice-lanes-cut" "undo-checkpoints"
              "timeout-vs-exhaustion" "nothing-zero-one"
              "thought-kernel-routing" "jit-plan-live-evidence"
              "knowledge-query-token" "recipe-birth-exec"
              ; the five families v3 measured at zero (2026-08-25): the
              ; curriculum taught machinery only; these glosses come from
              ; each family's own cells, never from sealed audit rows.
              "axioms-smallest-set" "axiom-1-states" "axiom-5-offer"
              "learn-distillation" "teachings-service"
              "control-choice-lanes" "ingest-name-build-observe"
              "ingest-equivalent-storage" "ingest-depth-threshold"
              "fail" "evaluate" "release" "dimensional-compression"
              "form-neutral-dictionary" "form-to-surface"))
    (defn fqt-semantic-sources ()
        (list
            (list "bml" "form/form-stdlib/bml-bmf-stream-curriculum.bml")
            (list "custom-bmf-grammar" "form/form-stdlib/bml-bmf-stream-curriculum.fk")
            (list "streaming-cursor" "form/form-stdlib/bml-bmf-stream-curriculum.fk")
            (list "no-tokenizer-prestep" "form/form-stdlib/bml-bmf-stream-curriculum.fk")
            (list "choice-lanes-cut" "form/form-stdlib/bml-bmf-control-curriculum.fk")
            (list "undo-checkpoints" "form/form-stdlib/bml-bmf-control-curriculum.fk")
            (list "timeout-vs-exhaustion" "form/form-stdlib/bml-bmf-control-curriculum.fk")
            (list "nothing-zero-one" "form/form-stdlib/bml-bmf-control-curriculum.fk")
            (list "thought-kernel-routing" "observe/inquiry-planes.fk")
            (list "jit-plan-live-evidence" "receipts/2026-06-30-form-native-jit-live-execution-evidence.md")
            (list "knowledge-query-token" "form/form-stdlib/tests/form-cli-heed-twophase-band.fk")
            (list "recipe-birth-exec" "form/form-stdlib/tests/form-cli-recipe-exec-session-band.fk")
            ; Public evaluation keeps its exact source rows disjoint.  These
            ; lessons are carried by the source-bound public curriculum that
            ; derives them, not by the heldout core-axioms source itself.
            (list "axioms-smallest-set" "form/form-stdlib/form-knowledge-axioms-public-curriculum.fk")
            (list "axiom-1-states" "form/form-stdlib/form-knowledge-axioms-public-curriculum.fk")
            (list "axiom-5-offer" "form/form-stdlib/form-knowledge-axioms-public-curriculum.fk")
            (list "learn-distillation" "learn/homecoming-distillation-corpus.fk")
            (list "teachings-service" "cognition/dialogue-covenant.fk")
            (list "control-choice-lanes" "control/choice-lane-core.fk")
            (list "ingest-name-build-observe" "ingest/name-build-observe.fk")
            ; Heldout v3 cites the two ingest cells directly. Teaching
            ; provenance stays on this public curriculum so the sealed
            ; sources remain disjoint, the axioms pattern.
            (list "ingest-equivalent-storage" "form/form-stdlib/form-knowledge-ingest-public-curriculum.fk")
            (list "ingest-depth-threshold" "form/form-stdlib/form-knowledge-ingest-public-curriculum.fk")
            (list "fail" "control/choice-lane-core.fk")
            (list "evaluate" "form/form-stdlib/tests/form-cli-recipe-exec-session-band.fk")
            (list "release" "receipts/2026-06-30-form-native-jit-live-execution-evidence.md")
            (list "dimensional-compression" "form/form-stdlib/form-cli-lora-writer.bml")
            (list "form-neutral-dictionary" "model/form-neutral-token-space.fk")
            (list "form-to-surface" "model/form-neutral-token-space.fk")))
    (defn fqt-source-of-loop (rows name)
        (if (eq (len rows) 0) ""
            (if (str_eq (nth (head rows) 0) name) (nth (head rows) 1)
                (fqt-source-of-loop (tail rows) name))))
    (defn fqt-source-of (name) (fqt-source-of-loop (fqt-semantic-sources) name))
    (defn fqt-sources-cover-loop (names)
        (if (eq (len names) 0) 1
            (if (gt (str_len (fqt-source-of (head names))) 0)
                (fqt-sources-cover-loop (tail names))
                0)))
    (defn fqt-sources-cover? ()
        (fqt-sources-cover-loop (fqt-semantic-curriculum)))
    (defn fqt-sources-readable-loop (rows)
        (if (eq (len rows) 0) 1
            (do (let s (read_file (nth (head rows) 1)))
                (if (nothing? s) 0
                    (if (gt (str_len s) 0)
                        (fqt-sources-readable-loop (tail rows))
                        0)))))
    (defn fqt-sources-readable? ()

    (defn fqt-situation (row) (nth row 2))
    (defn fqt-row-class (row) (nth row 1))
    (defn fqt-row-split (row) (nth row 0))

    (defn fqt-dim () 64)
    (defn fqt-zero-n (n) (if (eq n 0) (empty) (cons 0 (fqt-zero-n (sub n 1)))))
    (defn fqt-vzero () (fqt-zero-n (fqt-dim)))
    (defn fqt-vadd (a b)
        (if (eq (len a) 0) (empty)
            (cons (add (head a) (head b)) (fqt-vadd (tail a) (tail b)))))
    (defn fqt-vinc (v at i)
        (if (eq (len v) 0) (empty)
            (cons (if (eq i at) (add (head v) 1) (head v))
                  (fqt-vinc (tail v) at (add i 1)))))
    (defn fqt-dot (a b)
        (if (eq (len a) 0) 0
            (add (mul (head a) (head b)) (fqt-dot (tail a) (tail b)))))

    (defn fqt-features-walk (s i L v)
        (if (ge (add i 1) L) v
            (do (let h (mod (add (mul (str_byte_at s i) 31)
                                  (str_byte_at s (add i 1))) (fqt-dim)))
                (fqt-features-walk s (add i 1) L (fqt-vinc v h 0)))))
    (defn fqt-features (s) (fqt-features-walk s 0 (str_len s) (fqt-vzero)))

    (defn fqt-fit-class (rows class acc)
        (if (eq (len rows) 0) acc
            (do (let row (head rows))
                (fqt-fit-class (tail rows) class
                    (if (if (str_eq (fqt-row-split row) "train")
                            (str_eq (fqt-row-class row) class) 0)
                        (fqt-vadd acc (fqt-features (fqt-situation row)))
                        acc)))))
    (defn fqt-fit (rows names)
        (if (eq (len names) 0) (empty)
            (cons (fqt-fit-class rows (head names) (fqt-vzero))
                  (fqt-fit rows (tail names)))))

    (defn fqt-best (models feat i best-i best-dot best-norm)
        (if (eq (len models) 0) best-i
            (do (let dot (fqt-dot (head models) feat))
                (let norm (fqt-dot (head models) (head models)))
                (if (if (lt best-dot 0) 1
                        (gt (mul (mul dot dot) best-norm)
                            (mul (mul best-dot best-dot) norm)))
                    (fqt-best (tail models) feat (add i 1) i dot norm)
                    (fqt-best (tail models) feat (add i 1) best-i best-dot best-norm)))))
    (defn fqt-predict-index (models s)
        (fqt-best models (fqt-features s) 0 0 -1 1))

    ; the overlay's home: the local seed when one stands, else the committed
    ; one (form-stdlib/adapters/qwen-teach-overlay.lora) so every checkout
    ; applies the same adaptation at birth — persistent, part of the tree
    (defn fqt-lora-tracked-path () "form/form-stdlib/adapters/qwen-teach-overlay.lora")
    (defn fqt-lora-local-path () ".form-lora-adapter")
    (defn fqt-lora-path () (if (gt (file_size (fqt-lora-local-path)) 0) (fqt-lora-local-path) (fqt-lora-tracked-path)))
    (defn fqt-lora-scale () 1000)
    (defn fqt-pipe-head (s)
        (do (let p (str_find s "|" 0))
            (if (lt p 0) s (substring s 0 p))))
    (defn fqt-pipe-rest (s)
        (do (let p (str_find s "|" 0))
            (if (lt p 0) "" (substring s (add p 1) (str_len s)))))
    (defn fqt-pipe-nth (s n)
        (if (eq n 0) (fqt-pipe-head s)
            (fqt-pipe-nth (fqt-pipe-rest s) (sub n 1))))
    (defn fqt-comma-ints (s)
        (if (eq (str_len s) 0) (empty)
            (do (let p (str_find s "," 0))
                (if (lt p 0) (cons (str_to_int s) (empty))
                    (cons (str_to_int (substring s 0 p))
                          (fqt-comma-ints (substring s (add p 1) (str_len s))))))))
    (defn fqt-lora-dot (a b)
        (if (eq (len a) 0) 0
            (add (div (mul (head a) (head b)) (fqt-lora-scale))
                 (fqt-lora-dot (tail a) (tail b)))))
    (defn fqt-lora-scale-vec (v s)
        (if (eq (len v) 0) (empty)
            (cons (div (mul (head v) s) (fqt-lora-scale))
                  (fqt-lora-scale-vec (tail v) s))))
    (defn fqt-lora-add (a b)
        (if (eq (len a) 0) (empty)
            (cons (add (head a) (head b)) (fqt-lora-add (tail a) (tail b)))))
    ; Generate's Control: line uses this. Heldout centroid stays on raw features
    ; so the teach band does not depend on a gitignored adapter file.
    (defn fqt-lora-apply (feat)
        (if (le (file_size (fqt-lora-path)) 0) feat
            (do
                (let s (read_file (fqt-lora-path)))
                (if (not (str_eq (fqt-pipe-nth s 0) "lora-v1")) feat
                    (do
                        (let A (fqt-comma-ints (fqt-pipe-nth s 4)))
                        (let B (fqt-comma-ints (fqt-pipe-nth s 5)))
                        (if (and (eq (len A) (len feat)) (eq (len B) (len feat)))
                            (fqt-lora-add feat
                                (fqt-lora-scale-vec B (fqt-lora-dot A feat)))
                            feat))))))
    (defn fqt-adapted-features (s) (fqt-lora-apply (fqt-features s)))
    (defn fqt-adapter-applied? ()
        (if (le (file_size (fqt-lora-path)) 0) 0
            (if (eq (len (fqt-comma-ints (fqt-pipe-nth (read_file (fqt-lora-path)) 4)))
                    (fqt-dim))
                1 0)))

    (defn fqt-models () (fqt-fit (fqt-rows) (fqt-controls)))
    ; Short probes have no control situation. Do not invent a face for "hello".
    (defn fqt-verdict-index (s)

    (defn fqt-heldout-n-loop (rows)

    (defn fqt-seen-train? (rows input)
        (if (eq (len rows) 0) 0

                    (fqt-seen-train? all (fqt-situation (head rows)))
